_notice: CPCB health-impact descriptions, shown in English. These describe potential impacts and are not personal medical advice.

source.title: National Air Quality Index — health impacts by AQI category

categories.Satisfactory: May cause minor breathing discomfort to sensitive people.
categories.Moderate: May cause breathing discomfort to people with lung or heart disease, children, and older adults.
categories.Poor: May cause breathing discomfort on prolonged exposure; people with lung or heart disease may experience discomfort.
categories.Very Poor: May cause respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Effects may be more pronounced for people with lung or heart disease.
categories.Severe: May cause respiratory effects even in healthy people and serious health impacts for people with lung or heart disease. Effects may be pronounced even during light physical activity.
